platform_name: JEP 527: Post-Quantum Hybrid Key Exchange for TLS 1.3
product_name: JEP 527: Post-Quantum Hybrid Key Exchange for TLS 1.3
product_brief: Enhances Java TLS 1.3 security by implementing hybrid key exchange algorithms combining quantum-resistant and traditional methods.
pqc_capability_description: Implements hybrid key exchange for TLS 1.3 using ML-KEM combined with ECDHE. Supports X25519MLKEM768 (default), SecP256r1MLKEM768, and SecP384r1MLKEM1024. Delivered in JDK 27.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM-768, ML-KEM-1024, X25519, secp256r1, secp384r1, secp521r1, x448, ffdhe2048, ffdhe3072, ffdhe4096, ffdhe6144, ffdhe8192, RSA, ECDH
pqc_roadmap_details: Delivered in JDK 27. Future work may include pure ML-KEM non-hybrid schemes.
testing_&_validation_methods: Unit tests for client/server operation and named groups; interoperability testing against other TLS implementations.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: No changes to existing code required for default benefit; backward compatible via default scheme ordering.
